nodes.en: the woman who brought the news
the brahmin who tells of Sali
the charanas who foretold the flood
the Chola who marked the Himalaya
the hill people who brought gifts
the girl dressed as the goddess
the Jain monk on the road

gloss.note: The verse says கோளிப் பாகல், not பலா. Reading it as jackfruit comes from the commentary tradition, and I haven't checked that against a printed commentary.

nodes.en: the hero who lost his kingdom at dice
the great lady who set up the house
the hero who left home at his father's word
the woman who wove the mat
